question: Will the one-month change in U.S. advance retail and food services sales (Census, seasonally adjusted; computed from the level) for April 2026 (the latest monthly reading dated on or before 2026-04-15) be above 0.72%, its value for November 2025?

rule.threshold_basis: the latest reading as of 2026-01-15 (November 2025), rounded as shown
